title: "Failed loading controller" in the ros2_control spawner: 'type' param not defined, Loader for controller not found, empty params_file and Lyrical's missing parameters, measured
excerpt: The spawner only says Failed loading controller. The controller manager log says why: a missing type, a misspelled or uninstalled controller type, an empty params_file, or Lyrical not passing the manager's YAML to controllers. Causes and fixes measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
